title: Protect ASS conversion source paths from overwrite
summary: Prevent the ASS-to-SRT helper from overwriting its source, summary path, or an existing destination by default.
reason: Remediate P1 AUDIT-FIND-W05-001. Current bundled-runtime reproduction proved that the helper's unconditional atomic replace can replace source bytes when an input path is reused as output.
behavior_before: ASS-to-SRT CLI paths were not checked for canonical aliasing, and atomic writes unconditionally replaced any existing target, including the input media path.
behavior_after: The CLI rejects canonical aliases among input, SRT output, and summary JSON before extraction; it also rejects existing destinations and atomically publishes new output/summary files without replacement, including race-time collisions.
tests_added: tests/python/core/subtitles/test_ass_to_srt_helpers.py: source/output alias, summary aliases, existing destination, hard-link alias, Windows case variant, symlink capability case, and atomic no-clobber coverage.
manual_validation: Bundled Python disposable pre-fix reproduction - passed (source_replaced=True, defect confirmed)
Bundled-Python disposable reproduction before remediation: source_replaced=True.
Independent black-box CLI subprocess alias probe - passed: exit 2, alias rejected before ffmpeg, source SHA-256 unchanged

notes:
Finding disposition before remediation: confirmed. Linked audit errors were reviewed and are retained immutable historical evidence. Invariant: source inputs must never be overwritten. Required validation: bundled-Python path/CLI tests, ASS helper suite, subtitle conversion checks, summary refresh, and strict packet coverage. Representative real media is not required by the finding; only disposable fixtures are authorized for this batch. The related P3 AUDIT-FIND-W05-009 is a separate scratch-stage race and is not included. Python impact: yes; one existing Python CLI helper will gain validation and no-clobber commit behavior.
AUDIT-FIND-W05-001 red state: five safety cases failed before implementation; symlink case skipped because Windows symlink creation was unavailable. Hard-link and Windows case-variant alias coverage executed.
Repository-required project-index and feature-map regeneration updated six derived artifacts. The deterministic rebuild also incorporated pre-existing clean-HEAD catalog drift (including MP-CHANGE-2026-0720-031 and previously unindexed queue/WebView tests); no product behavior in those domains changed.
P1 independent validation used a separate black-box child-process probe because no subagent was requested. Security/path review confirmed no overwrite option, no source mutation, no protected-boundary relaxation, and fail-closed collision behavior.
